title: JobTrackerApp
subtitle: CPSC 210 class project · Java desktop application
summary: A Java desktop application inspired by the friction of managing co-op and full-time applications in spreadsheets.

sections.title: The workflow
sections.body: Organize opportunities across interested, planned, applied, accepted, rejected, and past-deadline states. Add or remove jobs, update their status, and record accepted-offer details.

sections.title: Keeping track
sections.body: The application includes deadline and follow-up notifications, a job table, and JSON save/load support so progress can be restored between sessions.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: A Swing interface sits alongside a Java job model and JSON persistence classes. The repository includes JUnit tests and event logging.
